name: io.github.zhuhuo4374/arki-chain
title: Arki Chain
description: On-chain verdicts for AI agents: is a token safe to touch, and what one address holds on 6 chains.

tools.name: chain_address_snapshot
tools.description: One EVM address -> native balance and tx count across 6 chains (BSC/ETH/Polygon/Arbitrum/Base/Optimism) in a single call. Returns a short verdict, not raw numbers.

tools.name: token_verdict
tools.description: Decide whether a token is safe to touch. Checks honeypot, sellability, open source, real mintability (owner-renounced aware), taxes, burned LP, and holding concentration counting ONLY personal wallets (contract holdings listed separately). Returns a risk verdict with reasons.

tools.name: chain_daily
tools.description: Current block height on 6 chains, usable as a snapshot baseline for citing on-chain data.
